meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你把第一个智能体接入聊天频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你刚部署好智能体服务，需要把它连上聊天频道
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and trigger a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up the agent service and need to connect it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 该技能引导你逐步创建第一个 NanoClaw Agent:选择渠道、提供你的用户 ID 与显示名、确认私聊平台 ID,然后自动创建 Agent 并给你发一条欢迎私信。
howto.when: 当渠道凭据已配置且服务运行时,首次为某个私聊频道创建 Agent、验证欢迎私信送达时使用。

say.text: 帮我创建第一个 NanoClaw Agent 并测试欢迎私信。
say.note: 技能会依次询问渠道、你的用户 ID 等信息。

say.text: 在 Telegram 上初始化第一个 Agent,发欢迎消息给我。
say.note: 会走 Telegram 的配对码流程。

say.text: 为 Slack 建第一个 Agent,验证私信能收到。
say.note: 需要你先给机器人发一条私信确认身份。

howto.what_en: Walks the operator through setting up the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: pick the channel, provide your user ID, display name and agent name, resolve the DM platform ID, then the script creates the agent and sends a welcome DM through the normal delivery path. Idempotent, safe to rerun.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you want to create the first agent for a DM channel and verify the welcome DM is delivered.

say_en.text: Create the first NanoClaw agent and test the welcome DM.
say_en.note: The skill will ask for channel, user ID, etc.

say_en.text: Initialize the first agent on Telegram and send me a welcome message.
Set up the first agent for Slack and verify the DM arrives.
say_en.note: You'll need to DM the bot once first.
